style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

source.scene: Inspect the named asset collection; do not use an unrelated active scene

target.interpretation: Reward useful native modeling and decoration inspired by the target. Do not reject a change solely because it differs from the source. Reject target drift only when it harms the chosen style, readability, role or locked technical contract. Original part counts and weak shapes are not automatically constraints.

generation.inspection: Raw selected target expresses requested cartoon design exploration; native editor retains functional connection profiles and actual registration rather than target caps/framing. No post-generation pixel editing.

constraints.modularFamily: Exact approved native straight conveyor family settings, rail/deck cross-section at incoming/outgoing connection planes, deck elevation/socket and UV7-period24-frame phase contract are fixed. Measure this corner original native intrinsic rotation, actual UV angular parameterization and incoming/outgoing tangents independently; never copy straight source orientation/action blindly. qualityCriteria.judgingPrinciple: Reward useful native improvements within modelingPolicy v2. Original part counts,weak blank surfaces and awkward supports are not fidelity requirements. ImageGen is a design target, never registration,continuity or unseen-view proof. No aesthetic score threshold or cosmetic technique is prescribed.

rankedVisibleOutcomes.outcome: A sturdy,crafted quarter-turn conveyor with clear deck,inside/outside rails and believable wood support. Improve the plain original construction toward the target’s fuller cartoon volume. Curved silhouette and support relationships remain coherent in all four facings; no apparent floating rail,unsupported corner,collapsed inner turn or weak slab.

Soft warm transitions reveal thickness and gentle edge reflections on the curved coral rails and slate slats. Highlights remain broad enough to read at use size, restrained enough to retain color, and continuous through matched module ends. No preferred horizontal light direction,one-sided bright stripe,ground shadow,blown edge or dark unlit quadrant.

Coral rail,blue-gray slate deck,honey wood support and optional restrained brass accents read as one family with the approved native straight. The deck is distinct from its grooves; wood retains visible warm body color. Neighbor joins do not expose abrupt tint/value/material changes.

A small amount of crafted detail gives the support/rail construction intent. Surface variation,fasteners or joinery may differ from the target if equally coherent and readable. Avoid flat blank wood,overscaled hardware,noisy grain,plastic glare,procedural swimming or copied ImageGen halos. Detail never intrudes into open ports or plate clearance.

At logical128px cell,narrow-phone/fractional55px and32px cells,recognize the turn,slat direction,rail thickness and warm support without relying on enlarged-only decoration. Every facing/frame remains free of black patches,coplanar shimmer,broken inner corners,exposed caps,clipping,alpha fringes and muddy merged parts. Real transparent export stays clean over light,dark and contrasting backgrounds.

All24 samples play forward at12fps as a smooth2s conveyor loop,with correct incoming-to-outgoing travel and no closure jump,phase reversal,stationary seam stripe or slat pulse at either port. Independently assembled corner+approved-family straights visibly matches an unbroken native assembly through both joins. A separate plate follows the existing staged centerline over the correct deck height.

proportionateEvidence.consumerAndScale: Use actual current browser SpriteScene/common-world raster path for connected and independent family assemblies,not a disconnected custom screenshot. Show representative logical128px,narrowphone/fractional55px and32px cell conditions,including contrasting backgrounds and at least a fractional grid/camera placement. proportionateEvidence.residuals: Report fullRGBA residuals,join-localized RGB+alpha statistics and location masks for connected versus independent/unbroken output at the representative scale/phase cases. Distinguish sampling/quantization from geometry,alpha or shading defects. Preserve approved family seam-equivalence within its documented quantization allowance; no background-colored crack,material stripe,alpha loss or temporally persistent seam may be waived by a global average. Native capture continuity and actual consumer continuity are separate evidence.
proportionateEvidence.currentCatalogChecks: Representative actual browser fourfacings,repeated spacing and connected/staged-plate study at desktop and320px phone,including normalplayback and pause/scrub.
